units.source_text: 归途中，我们驾车绕过一个碧绿的小湖。

en.t: On the way back, we drove around a small emerald-green lake.

units.source_text: 在晚秋的午后，这个小湖也显得格外幽静，出人意料地美。

en.t: In the late-autumn afternoon, the little lake too seemed especially quiet, and unexpectedly beautiful.

units.source_text: 名人也从车厢里出来，站着观赏了一会儿。

en.t: The master also came out of the car and stood there admiring it for a while.
